title: Geography of South America: Brazil. - Rev. ed.
brief_description: Designed to show the great variety of urban and rural life styles which exist in Brazil. Depicts life in the vast Amazon Basin, on coffee and cocoa plantations, in the great coastal cities, and in Brazilia. The Brazilian economy is painted in glowing terms. Suitable for lower and middle secondary levels.
